title: DevFest Berlin 2026
description: Berlin's flagship community-driven developer festival organized by local Google Developer Groups. Coming to SRH Berlin on November 14, 2026.

legal.representedBy: the board: Tsz Ho Tsai (chair), Aleksandr Mir (deputy chair), Elmira Jamaljamaliannezhad (secretary)

venue.name: SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences

speakerPerks.title: Full Conference Pass
speakerPerks.description: Complimentary all-day access to all keynote sessions, workshops, catering, and social events.

speakerPerks.title: Talk Recording & Exposure
speakerPerks.description: High-definition session recording published to community channels to share your expertise globally.

speakerPerks.title: Support for First-Time Speakers
speakerPerks.description: Slide coaching, dry-run feedback, and dedicated speaker buddies for new and underrepresented voices.

host.name: Esra Kadah
host.role: Google Developer Expert for Flutter & Dart

challenges.title: The Backyard Barista
challenges.summary: Build a specialty coffee companion in Google AI Studio: a Gemini barista that picks beans, roasts and milk for your taste, then add a brew timer, a shopping list and a Firebase recipe journal.

challenges.title: Launch your portfolio website with AI
challenges.summary: Describe yourself, let Google AI Studio build a personal portfolio site, then publish it to Cloud Run.

challenges.title: Launch a multiplayer game with AI
challenges.summary: Build a turn-based browser game with Firestore and Google Sign-In, set up for you by AI Studio, and deploy it to Cloud Run.

challenges.title: Build with Google Maps Platform and AI
challenges.summary: Build a map explorer with geocoding, Gemini-generated local facts and Maps grounding, then deploy it to Cloud Run.

vibeLoungeSlots.title: Open build: pick any challenge
vibeLoungeSlots.focus: Choose any of the four challenges, build it with Google AI Studio and Gemini, and deploy it live.

vibeLoungeSlots.title: Open build: pick any challenge
vibeLoungeSlots.focus: Same four challenges, fresh batch. Mentors in the room help you get unstuck.

vibeLoungeSlots.title: Open build & showcase
vibeLoungeSlots.focus: Build any challenge, demo your live app, and claim the official Vibe Lounge badge.

sponsorship.title: Partner with DevFest Berlin
sponsorship.pitch: DevFest Berlin is run by volunteers from Berlin's developer communities. Partners make it possible, and meet more than 200 developers, designers and tech leads in one day.
